safety: Do not enter floodwater or damaged buildings to take a photo. Report only from a secure location.
footer: Decision support only. Estimates carry uncertainty; incident commander decides.
projection: Projection assumes the water keeps rising at the estimated rate. Flash floods peak and recede; this is a worst-case planning scenario, not a forecast.
sms: [ALERT] {hazard} warning. If it is safe to do so, report conditions: {link}. Do not enter floodwater or damaged buildings.
flood_tips: Move to higher ground or an upper floor. Never walk or drive through moving water. Stay away from power lines. Do not enter water for a photo.
collapse_tips: Do not re-enter a damaged building. Stay clear of leaning walls. If trapped, cover your mouth and signal by tapping if possible.
